name: Dervish Step (Combat)
body:
You move with the speed and grace of a sunbeam, dancing around claws and blades to reposition into a perfect place to strike.

Prerequisite(s): Perform (dance) 9 ranks, Dodge, Mobility, War Dancer.

Benefit(s): When you successfully negate an attack by using the War Dance feat, you can immediately move up to 10 feet as part of that same immediate action. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. You must end this movement in a space that is still within the original attacker’s threatened area.
